verdict.rationale: Gecko documents automation-like features: scan schedules managed via API, webhooks, and PR checks. The evidence does not show versioning, review history, or rollback of those automations. Release/version resolution covers scanner image releases, and fix PRs patch the user's code; neither is versioning or rollback of user automations, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
